title: Attachment and compatibility
learning_outcomes: Explain attachment patterns in the context of attachment and compatibility.
Compare and distinguish compatibility dimensions in the context of attachment and compatibility.
Apply needs in the context of attachment and compatibility.
Evaluate and justify decisions about boundaries in the context of attachment and compatibility.

lessons.title: Attachment patterns
lessons.outcome: Explain attachment patterns in the context of attachment and compatibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving attachment patterns; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to compatibility conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain attachment patterns from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of attachment patterns; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Compatibility dimensions
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish compatibility dimensions in the context of attachment and compatibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving compatibility dimensions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to compatibility conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain compatibility dimensions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of compatibility dimensions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Needs
lessons.outcome: Apply needs in the context of attachment and compatibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving needs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to compatibility conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain needs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of needs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Boundaries
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about boundaries in the context of attachment and compatibility.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving boundaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to compatibility conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain boundaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of attachment patterns; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of compatibility dimensions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of needs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
